evidence: Clicking "New Resume" opened editor titled "Untitled Resume" with empty Contact fields and tabs for Summary, Experience, Education, Skills, Template, Sections; live preview shows placeholder "Your Name".

issue: No validation on experience date ranges
actual: With start date Jan 2020, setting the end date to May 2019 (before start) was accepted with no error message, and the preview rendered "Jan 2020 - May 2019". Setting the end date to Sep 2030 (future; today is 2026-08-27) was likewise accepted and rendered as "Jan 2020 - Sep 2030". The month inputs carry no max attribute and no inline/toast feedback appears on change or blur.

issue: No validation on experience or education date ranges
actual: Experience: start Jan 2020 with end May 2019 was accepted silently and rendered "Jan 2020 - May 2019"; end Sep 2030 (future; today 2026-08-27) also accepted, rendered "Jan 2020 - Sep 2030". Education: start Sep 2013 with end Jan 2012 accepted, rendered "Sep 2013 - Jan 2012". No inline error, toast, or field highlight appeared on change or blur; month inputs have no max attribute.

evidence: Both experience and education use input[type=month]; preview renders consistent "MMM YYYY - MMM YYYY" (e.g. "Jan 2020 - Jun 2023", "Sep 2013 - Jun 2017"). Checking "I currently work here" on Acme Corp cleared the end date (value="") and set disabled=true; preview showed "Jan 2020 - Present".

Contact fields (name/email/phone/location/LinkedIn/website) and summary accepted edits. Experience: added 2 entries, edited fields, reordered via ↑/↓ (companies swapped Acme/Globex and back). Education: added 2nd entry, reordered (Community College moved above UW), deleted it leaving only UW. Skills: added TypeScript & React, changed TypeScript level Intermediate→Expert, added and removed TempSkill.

Every field edit (contact, summary, experience, education, skills) appeared in the Live Preview immediately with no save action; e.g. preview updated to "Alice Johnson / alice@example.com / Seattle, WA" right after filling contact form. Template switching verified under FT-2 also updates preview instantly.

Template tab offers Modern, Classic, Minimal. Switching Modern→Classic→Minimal changed preview rendering (Modern "Professional Summary"/hyphen dates; Classic uppercase headings with "•" contact separators and en-dash dates; Minimal uppercase contact line with stacked dates) while all content (Alice Johnson, summary, Acme/Globex, UW, TypeScript/React) remained intact in every style.

Sections tab lists 5 sections with ↑/↓ reorder and visibility switches. Moving Skills up reordered to Contact, Summary, Experience, Skills, Education and the preview immediately showed SKILLS before EDUCATION. Toggling Education's switch to off (aria-checked=false) removed the whole education block from the preview; toggling back restored it.

issue: Customized summary heading not rendered in Minimal template
actual: Section headings were renamed to "About Me", "Career History", "Core Competencies", "Academics". Modern preview shows all four; Classic shows ABOUT ME / CAREER HISTORY / CORE COMPETENCIES / ACADEMICS. Minimal renders CAREER HISTORY, CORE COMPETENCIES and ACADEMICS but prints the summary paragraph with no heading at all — "About Me" is absent (the same happened with the default "Professional Summary" label), even though the Summary section is visible and has content.

evidence: "Hide Preview" removed the Live Preview pane and the button became "Show Preview"; clicking it restored the preview with all content (Alice Johnson, ABOUT ME, CAREER HISTORY...) and the previously selected Classic template styling intact. Editor tab (Template) and field values were unaffected.

Classic preview rendered all visible sections having content: contact block, ABOUT ME summary, CAREER HISTORY (both jobs), CORE COMPETENCIES (TypeScript • React), ACADEMICS (UW with GPA and dates). With the viewport shrunk to 500px the document scrollHeight (874) exceeded innerHeight (500) and scrolling moved scrollY to 374, exposing the end of the resume ("Sep 2013 – Jun 2017").

issue: Empty/whitespace rename silently reverts with no validation feedback
actual: Renaming the title to "   " (whitespace) and to "" (empty) and pressing Enter both left the title as "Untitled Resume" (correct retention), but no validation message was shown: the Sonner notifications region stayed empty and no inline error or field highlight appeared — the input simply collapsed back to the heading, giving the user no indication why the rename was rejected.

evidence: After switching among all editor tabs, returning to the dashboard and reopening "Backend Engineer Resume", contact inputs still held Alice Johnson / alice@example.com / (555) 987-6543 / Seattle, WA / linkedin.com/in/alicej / alicej.dev, and the preview still showed the summary, both jobs (Acme, Globex), UW education with GPA 3.9, and skills TypeScript • React.
Renamed "Untitled Resume" → "Backend Engineer Resume"; editor header shows "Backend Engineer Resume" and the dashboard card heading shows the identical title.

Moving Skills above Education and toggling Education off/on updated the preview instantly on each click. After navigating to other tabs, back to the dashboard and reopening the resume, the preview still rendered CORE COMPETENCIES before ACADEMICS with Education visible, i.e. the custom layout persisted within the session.

No save button exists; edits made across Contact/Summary/Experience/Education/Skills/Template/Sections tabs were all present after returning to the dashboard and reopening the resume. evidence: Card menu → Duplicate created "Backend Engineer Resume (Copy)" with all source content; renamed it via card menu → Rename to "Startup Backend Resume". Editing the copy (name → "Alice J. Copy", location → Austin TX, summary → "COPY SUMMARY...") left the source resume showing Alice Johnson / Seattle, WA / original summary.

Session holds 6 distinct resumes simultaneously: Data Analyst Application, Startup Backend Resume, Backend Engineer Resume (all created/edited this session) plus the 3 seeded ones. Each opens with its own independent content and template.

Search "backend" (lowercase) matched "Startup Backend Resume" and "Backend Engineer Resume"; "RESUME" (uppercase) matched all 5 titles containing "Resume" — case-insensitive both ways. Clearing the box restored all 6 resumes. Sort combobox "Newest First" listed Data Analyst / Startup Backend / Backend Engineer / Product Designer (Feb 25 2024) / Marketing (Feb 10 2024) / Software Engineer (Jan 20 2024); "Oldest First" produced the exact reverse order.

actual: The dashboard's only filter controls are a single text input (placeholder "Search resumes...") and a sort combobox offering Newest First / Oldest First / Title A-Z / Title Z-A. There is no date input, no date-range picker, and no clear-date control anywhere on the dashboard (main contains exactly one input, of type=text), so narrowing resumes by an exact creation date or a date range is impossible.

issue: No persistence — all resume changes lost on reload
actual: Before reload the dashboard listed Software Engineer Resume, Product Designer Resume, Backend Engineer Resume (created+renamed+edited), Startup Backend Resume (duplicated+renamed+edited) and Data Analyst Application (created), with Marketing Manager Resume deleted. After reloading http://localhost:6005/ the list reverted to only the 3 seeded resumes (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer): the 3 created/duplicated resumes disappeared, the renames and content edits were lost, and the deleted Marketing Manager Resume reappeared. Both localStorage and sessionStorage contain zero keys, so state is held only in memory.
